name: Dragon roost
desc: the high perch of something enormous, usually shot empty so the audience does the maths
tags: jagged mountain peak roost, claw-scored stone, scorched black rock, huge nest of broken tree trunks, scattered bones, sheer drop on all sides, distant peaks far below, wind torn cloud
prose: a roost on a jagged mountain peak, the stone gouged by huge claws and scorched black, a nest built from broken tree trunks with bones scattered through it, a sheer drop on every side and distant peaks far below
note: Naming the dragon hijacks the frame and you get a portrait of a dragon instead of a location - this is the EMPTY roost. It reads as inhabited through scale marks only: claw gouges in the rock, scorching, bones, a nest made of whole tree trunks. Keep the drop and the peaks below or it flattens into any rocky outcrop.
